title: 1787-P: Taurine Supplementation Combined with Multicomponent Training Reduces Adipocyte Area in Older Women with Sarcopenic Obesity

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Introduction and Objective: Adipocyte hypertrophy, linked to obesity, contributes to chronic inflammation and insulin resistance. Physical exercise and taurine supplementation may improve adipose tissue function by activating lipolysis and modulating inflammation. However, their combined effects in older adults remain unexplored. This study evaluates the impact of exercise and taurine supplementation on adipocyte area in older women with sarcopenic obesity.</jats:p> <jats:p>Methods: This randomized clinical trial included 35 women over 60 years old (BMI 30-40 kg/m², appendicular lean mass <0.512 kg/BMI, and handgrip strength <0.56 kgf). Exclusion criteria included smoking and alcoholism. Participants were assigned to four groups: exercise plus taurine (GTAU+EX), exercise plus placebo (GPLA+EX), taurine (GTAU) or placebo only (GPLA). Interventions lasted 16 weeks, combining multicomponent training (resistance, aerobic, and proprioceptive exercises, 3x/week) with 3 g/day taurine supplementation. Blood samples were collected for irisin levels, REE was assessed via indirect calorimetry, and subcutaneous adipose tissue biopsies were analyzed. The study (NCT05415176) was ethically approved (56995022.4.0000.5659). Two-way repeated measures ANOVA was performed.</jats:p> <jats:p>Results: Preliminary results show that taurine with exercise reduces adipocyte area (mean difference : -5598.53 μm², 95% CI : -8476.80 to -2720.26; p=0.014). Exercised groups (GPLA+EX and GTAU+EX) increased REE by 151.4 kcal (95% CI: 6.3-296.5; p=0.04) and 334.9 kcal (95% CI: 198.1-471.7; p<0.001), respectively, accompanied by an increase in plasma irisin levels, without statistical significance (p=0.053).</jats:p> <jats:p>Conclusion: These findings suggest that taurine combined with exercise may reduce adipocyte size, offering a potential strategy for managing obesity-related diseases. Future analyses aim to elucidate the underlying mechanisms.</jats:p> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Disclosure</jats:title> <jats:p>G.U. Ortiz: None. G. Abud: None. G.R. Teixeira: None. M.A. Tavares: None.
